recognize_zh: 周邊血可見大卵圓形紅血球、淚滴與碎片紅血球及多分葉嗜中性球（插圖為嗜鹼性點彩）；骨髓中紅系前驅細胞體積大、染色質呈細緻篩孔狀且核質發育不同步，並有巨大後骨髓球，切片呈大量幼稚細胞易被誤認為白血病。
features: PB (A): marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop and fragmented cells, and a hypersegmented neutrophil; inset shows basophilic stippling
Aspirate (B): hypercellular with erythroid predominance; many large precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Aspirate (C): megaloblasts with open, finely stippled (sieve-like) chromatin and nuclear–cytoplasmic asynchrony; giant cells with ribbon-like/mitotic chromatin
Giant metamyelocyte/band forms and dysplastic granulocytes
Biopsy (D): sheets of large immature cells with open chromatin and scattered eosinophilic precursors, mimicking acute leukemia
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, teardrop cells, schistocytes, basophilic stippling and a hypersegmented neutrophil. The bone marrow aspirate is hypercellular with erythroid hyperplasia and megaloblastic maturation, characterized by large precursors with finely stippled open chromatin and nuclear–cytoplasmic asynchrony, together with giant granulocytic forms. The core biopsy shows sheets of large immature-appearing cells that can mimic acute leukemia. In an exclusively breastfed infant with low serum B12, findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows ≥80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, usually complex/TP53-mutated, and does not correct with B12 replacement.
MDS megaloblastoid change occurs with normal B12/folate, clonal cytogenetics and persistent dysplasia, rather than reversing after replacement.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by serum/RBC folate and methylmalonic acid (elevated only in B12 deficiency).
CDA shows binucleated/internuclear bridging erythroblasts with normal vitamin levels and lacks hypersegmented neutrophils and giant metamyelocytes.
